initialFinding: Mobile and tablet sticky headers covered step progress and count after anchor navigation.
correction: Measure the header border-box height using ResizeObserver and reserve that height plus 16 CSS pixels for anchor scrolling; clean up observers, listeners and the custom property.
reviewScope: The initial review inspected 13 valid presentation captures and source. The verdict pass scored the original anchor finding and corrected equivalent-reflow evidence using seven current captures plus three actual post-navigation viewport frames. No regression from the fix was identified.
limits: Equivalent reflow is not an actual OS or browser zoom-setting test.
The reviewer inspected source and captures, and did not independently run the browser suite.
Fixtures remain SIMULATED; live idle/configuration-blocked views provide no new live anonymity, payment or sponsor acceptance.
